question: Does effect differ by cause-difference under anvaya-vyatireka?
premises: not from cause-difference would difference be in effect
if it conforms to that invariable-concomitance-and-exclusion
inference: Anvaya-vyatireka conformity decides; bare cause-difference does not.
plain_english: Not from cause-difference would difference be in effect — and that is incoherent, if it conforms to that invariable-concomitance-and-exclusion.
